FN-KXI3A55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 4
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/04/2025
Senate Bill 4 as introduced could increase receipts to certain county or municipal governments
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: (1) the amount of funds
reimbursed by nonpublic schools for the salary, benefits, and other costs associated with
providing a school resource officer to a nonpublic school; and (2) the amount otherwise
reimbursed by the nonpublic school absent the provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of local law enforcement
entities by an undetermined amount for the provision of security, traffic control and other
similar services provided to nonpublic schools.
